description: Defines the cryptographic signing requirements for release provenance. RC releases may publish unsigned provenance classified as signing-not-configured. Stable releases must include valid cryptographic signatures.

signingMethods.name: Sigstore Keyless Signing
signingMethods.description: Keyless signing using OpenID Connect (OIDC) federation via cosign. The GitHub Actions OIDC token serves as the identity provider.
requirements: GitHub Actions environment with id-token: write permission

signingMethods.name: GPG Key Signing
signingMethods.description: Traditional GPG key-based signing using a stored private key. Fallback method when Sigstore keyless is unavailable.
signingMethods.identityProvider: GPG key stored in GitHub Secrets

signingMethods.name: Vault/HSM-Based Signing
signingMethods.description: HashiCorp Vault Transit engine or HSM PKCS#11 interface for enterprise-grade signing.
requirements: HashiCorp Vault instance configured with Transit engine
AppRole credentials stored as GitHub Secrets
HSM device or cloud HSM service available

signing-not-configured.description: Provenance is generated but lacks cryptographic signing. Unsigned provenance is acceptable for RC releases only.
signing-not-configured.rcPolicy: Acceptable. Provenance is generated but classified as signing-not-configured.
signing-not-configured.stablePolicy: Must be resolved. A signing key must be configured and all provenance statements must include valid signatures.
requiredActions: Configure at least one signing method from signingMethods
Update generate-provenance.ts to include signatures when signing is available
Document the signing method and verification instructions in release notes

signing-configured.description: Provenance includes a valid cryptographic signature from a configured signing key.
signing-configured.stablePolicy: Required. All stable release provenance must include valid signatures.

signing-verified.description: Provenance signature has been verified against the signing certificate or public key.
signing-verified.stablePolicy: Recommended. Automated verification in CI provides additional assurance.

signatureFormat.description: Signatures follow the in-toto Envelope format with a signatures array at the top level of the provenance JSON document.

v0.1.0-rc.1.reason: RC release. Signing not yet configured. Provenance is generated unsigned with signing-not-configured classification.

v0.1.0.reason: Stable release. Sigstore keyless signing workflow configured at .github/workflows/sign-release.yaml. Trigger the workflow via workflow_dispatch to sign existing v0.1.0 provenance artifacts.

tasks: Add cosign installation step to release workflow
Add id-token: write permission to release workflow
Sign provenance after generation using cosign sign-blob
Add signature verification step to release workflow
Update generate-provenance.ts to include signatures when available
Document verification instructions in release notes
Create dedicated signing workflow triggered by tag push
Automate keyless signing via GitHub OIDC
Add SLSA provenance generation using slsa-github-generator
Publish signatures to Rekor transparency log
Add automated signature verification in CI
Integrate with HashiCorp Vault Transit engine
Add audit logging for all signing operations

sigstore-keyless.description: Verify Sigstore keyless-signed provenance using the certificate chain and OIDC issuer.

gpg-key.description: Verify GPG-signed provenance using the signer's public key.

notes: Sigstore keyless signing workflow created at .github/workflows/sign-release.yaml
Workflow triggers on tag push (v*.*.*) and workflow_dispatch
No key management required — uses GitHub Actions OIDC token
Signatures are committed back to the repository after signing
G010 gate will pass for releases signed via this workflow
